thread:
carmen (sales): Quick sync — PulseAI wants a 36h POC. They need an ephemeral Dedicated environment: 3 reserved GPUs with elastic warm pool of 2 prewarmed slots, scheduled canary burst to 11 GPUs for two 45-min demo blocks/day. Also need a scoped hosted API key, IP allowlist, and optional VPC peering. Can infra and runtime confirm feasibility and a rough cost?

noah (solutions): Couple clarifying Qs: which model and typical seq? public demo link? any hard latency SLAs?

carmen (sales): Model: open-llama-70b-int8, typical seq 768, occasional 2048. Public demo for partners; target tail latency <400ms. Peak concurrent demo users ~90.

mei (eng-runtime): 70b-int8 at 2048 is heavy. For target latency we should do prewarmed slots + aggressive batching. Proposal: reserved=3, prewarm=2, canary_burst=+8 (to 11), canary_percent=30% (burst only serves a fraction initially), burst_smoothing=15s to avoid sudden kernel thrash. Also pin model hash. Recommend canary fallback to 13B-quant if queue exceeds 60s.

fer (eng-infra): We can create an ephemeral pool with those knobs. CLI we will run (internal):

```
rictl pool create \
  --name pulseai-poc \
  --reserved 3 \
  --prewarm 2 \
  --burst-max 11 \
  --canary-percent 30 \
  --burst-smoothing 15s \
  --schedule "2026-08-18T12:00Z/2026-08-20T00:00Z" \
  --rbac "team:pulseai-poc" \
  --notes "ephemeral POC: staged canary burst + prewarm; rotate key; ip allowlist/peering"
```

fer (eng-infra): For peering we need their CIDR and a peering SLA. If they pick IP allowlist we'll issue a rotated key with 72h TTL. Also need finance approval for demo buffer.

rita (security): Security wants an ephemeral key TTL=72h, least privilege role, and signed AUP for peering. If peering requested, we also need completed security questionnaire and SOC contact. We'll run a quick surface scan on any demo assets.

sam (finance): Quick back-of-envelope cost: reserved 3 GPUs x 2 days ~= ~144 GPU-hrs reserved; prewarm ~12 GPU-hrs; possible burst (if fully used) up to ~132 GPU-hrs. Ballpark incremental cost $3k-$7k. I can provision a $2k demo credit buffer; need approval to increase if forecasted burst >$5k.

noah (solutions): I'll draft the POC runbook with steps: create pool, rotate key + attach allowlist, enable canary burst, pin model, set token-cost-alerts, and dry-run checklist. Also add an ops-facing kill switch and a console toggle to reduce canary percent in-flight.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-POC-5610 assigned to fer (eng-infra)

fer (eng-infra): I'll provision once we have: final schedule (confirmed), CIDR or IP list if not peering, security questionnaire status, and finance buffer confirmation. ETA: provision within 48hrs of inputs.

mei (eng-runtime): Two runtime safeguards before demo: 1) enable token-level cost tracing and a rolling 5-min forecast to auto-disable burst if spend rate > $700/hr; 2) pin model to avoid config drift. I'll add a canary dashboard.

sam (finance): Approving $2k buffer. If spend forecast >$5k alert me immediately.

carmen (sales): I'll get CIDR and their SOC contact today and confirm schedule. Please aim to have infra ready by 2026-08-16 for a dry-run. Anything else blocking?

rita (security): Nothing else on our side besides the questionnaire and AUP for peering. If they accept IP allowlist we can move faster.

noah (solutions): I'll post the runbook draft here after lunch. Carmen, I'll include the kill-switch run steps and how to throttle canary percent.

carmen (sales): Thanks all :thumbsup:
